title: GIT-C read-only Git baseline inspector: `badf_gate.py git-baseline` renders the GIT_BASELINED record (GIT-O0, writes nothing) + repository-state subskill
objective: Make the badf-git BASELINE stage (git-cycle.md section 2 / GIT_BASELINED) a record a tool measures instead of a claim an agent types: a deterministic, read-only `badf_gate.py git-baseline [<path>]` subcommand that prints one JSON git-baseline record to stdout -- repository identity, worktree path / branch or detached / linked-worktree flag, working-tree and index status as counts only (staged, unstaged, untracked, stash), target ref + SHA + tree (origin/<default> as known locally), source ref + HEAD SHA + tree, merge base, ahead/behind, head_is_ancestor_of_target, honest no-fetch remote freshness, policy_epoch, disposition -- and a `BADF GATE PASS` line; writes nothing, performs no network operation, never mutates refs, index, worktree, stash or reflog. Three fail-closed refusals (not a git repository; no origin/<default>; unborn HEAD) exit 1 with a BLOCKED reason. A declarative subskill skills/badf-git/subskills/repository-state/SKILL.md routes to it. A CI step runs it on the PR runner (detached refs/pull/N/merge) as a positive control on real infrastructure.
business_value: badf_gate.py resolves an authority baseline and reads revisions but has no working-tree/index/worktree observation at all; BADF's own G07 dossiers bind source_revision: HEAD symbolically; the composition tuple CI computes is printed to a log and recorded nowhere; and this session found two agents in one working tree with no record of that state. The inspector is the producer of most GIT_BASELINED fields, the prerequisite for GIT-D/E/G tooling, and stays at GIT-O0 so it adds no authority and no mutation path -- GTGM v0.1 sections 4, 15 and 17 (GIT-C).
in_scope: badf_gate.py: `git-baseline [<path>]` subcommand (default: BADF's own root) built on the existing helpers (a path-aware git call like badf_compose.py's, self_repository, DEFAULT_BRANCH, the 0/1/2/3 exit convention); JSON record to stdout + PASS line; three refusals
skills/badf-git/subskills/repository-state/SKILL.md (declarative router to the subcommand) registered IMPLEMENTED, C1, allowed_tools [], real digest; badf-git root stays DESIGNED
.github/workflows/badf-gates.yml: a read-only `git-baseline` step on the runner (positive control; detached HEAD case)
tests/test_badf_git_baseline.py (12 tests, failing-first, scratch clones via tests/_scratch.seed_clone; read-only and determinism proofs)
GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md doctrine section; own G07 self-dossier; lockfile re-signed
out_of_scope: any mutation (fetch, checkout, worktree add, stash, clean) -- GIT-D and later; any network call
composition tuple / expected_result_tree / evidence-object writing -- GIT-E; GitHub API, PR/ruleset inspection -- GIT-F
a scripts/badf_git.py or any second validator (GIT-I12); test_set_epoch (BADF defines none -- declared as non-coverage); advancing badf-git root beyond DESIGNED
acceptance_criteria: clean checkout at origin/<default>: GIT_BASELINED, ahead=0 behind=0, merge_base == head == target, equal trees, zero counts, exit 0; topic branch: ahead=1, merge_base == target; behind: behind=1, head_is_ancestor_of_target true; detached: head_kind detached, source_ref null -- also on the CI PR runner

dirty state reported as counts only (no path, no content); the three refusals exit 1 BLOCKED and each is load-bearing (mutation); read-only proven (status/reflog/stash/index byte-identical, no files created); deterministic modulo observed_at

record keys cover every git-cycle.md section 2 BASELINE item except test-set epoch (declared non-coverage); repository-state registered IMPLEMENTED C1 allowed_tools [] with a real digest, root stays DESIGNED
no Git authority, no mutation path, no network, no new script, no schema change; authority-matrix, tool-registry, schemas unchanged; repo integrity clean; compose green; PyYAML-absent suite green

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR
